excluded_content.note: Weapon quality names are controlled UI option labels, not entity names, but their serializer is unsafe without integration guard. QualityRules are mechanical prose and intentionally untranslated.

hardcoded_and_integration_findings.problem: qualities.write stores localized nameOf(source,key); parseWeaponQualities accepts only A-Za-z, spaces and hyphens. Enabling the 40 translated quality labels without a serialization guard can break qualities after picker save. The same formatter serves weapon/psychic attack/upgrades and powerSubtypes.
hardcoded_and_integration_findings.required_action: Keep canonical English names or keys when serializing; translate visible labels only. If a guard is unavailable, exclude these 40 native keys from the merged language file and translate their rendered labels through a targeted adapter. Do not translate names from entity catalogs.
hardcoded_and_integration_findings.resolution: scripts/system-bridge.mjs synchronously installs picker-compat.mjs; all 40 English canonical names and parser round-trips are tested.

shared_merge_note: Root owns conflicts with actor-ui.ru.json. FirstAidWithdrawalChanges/Duration uses Последействие because runtime applies these after the primary effect; review semantic choice when merging.

picker_compatibility.integration: Call synchronously once with the statically imported DH2E_PICKER_FORMATS and the parsed canonical English JSON before sheet picker writes. Returns true on installation and false on repeated installation. Only qualities.write is replaced.
picker_compatibility.implementation: Known quality keys are replaced in a new picks array with exact English labels from the original en.json. The original writer then keeps those labels verbatim because source lookup matches keys exactly; its value formatting remains unchanged. Unknown entries are passed through, preserving original behavior. The source catalog, original reader, other formats, original picks, game documents and system files are unchanged.

picker_compatibility.limit: This patch does not broaden parsers or migrate already corrupted saved data. The original numeric parseWeaponQualities ignores symbolic parameters such as X/PR/2; these are preserved exactly and round-trip through the original picker reader, matching original system behavior.
